items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ackerson was his name. They were calling him A.K. or something like that. Those were the two horn players that I was listening to

ctx.x: I can’t – because I used to go to school, and he lived on my way to school. This cat had a beautiful sound, very similar to Bird and Scoops Carry, insomuch as he was playing without any vibrato. I’m trying – Ackerson was his name. They were calling him A.K. or something like that. Those were the two horn players that I was listening to, because the tenor players just wasn’t saying anything. Everybody was copying Hawk and Pres. But these three men, Bird, Scoops Carry, and Ackerson, had another way, insomuch as the…
That’s funny how everybody had nicknames back then, Goon Garner and Scoops Carry.
